name: Petite Jade Porcelain Tea Ensemble
marketing_tip: Small in size but grand in elegance, this petite set is perfect for intimate tastings.
body: This small-scale set highlights the exquisite craftsmanship of mutton fat jade porcelain in a compact form factor. It's an ideal choice for those who appreciate the subtle nuances of high-mountain teas in smaller servings.
